class.name: SeedServer
class.brief_description: Holds one global seed and derives named random streams and noise generators from it.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all random streams and noise generators. [member global_seed] is kept.

method.name: get_derived_seed
method.description: Returns the seed that a stream called [param name] gets from the current [member global_seed]. A noise generator gets the upper 32 bits of this value ([code]get_derived_seed(name) >> 32[/code]).

method.name: get_noise
method.description: Returns the noise generator called [param name]. On first use a new [FastNoiseLite] is created and gets the seed derived from [member global_seed] and [param name]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the engine was built without the noise module. [b]Note:[/b] Only the seed is managed. Other settings of the noise (type, frequency, fractal) are set by the caller.

method.name: get_noise_names
method.description: Returns the names of all noise generators, sorted.

method.name: get_rng
method.description: Returns the random stream called [param name]. On first use it is created with the seed derived from [member global_seed] and [param name]; later calls return the same object.

method.name: get_rng_names
method.description: Returns the names of all random streams, sorted.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the global seed and the state of every random stream as a [Dictionary] with the keys [code]"global_seed"[/code] ([int]) and [code]"streams"[/code] (a [Dictionary] of stream name to [member RandomNumberGenerator.state]). Store it in a save game and pass it to [method set_state] to continue a run.

method.name: has_noise
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a noise generator called [param name] exists.

method.name: has_rng
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a random stream called [param name] exists.

method.name: randomize_seed
method.description: Sets [member global_seed] to a random value based on the time and returns it. Use it for a new, unpredictable run; store the returned value to reproduce it.

method.name: register_noise
method.description: Registers [param noise] under [param name] and sets its seed from [member global_seed] and [param name]. [param noise] can be any [Resource] with an integer property [code]seed[/code], for example [FastNoiseLite] or a noise class from a GDExtension. Replaces a noise generator with the same name.

method.name: remove_noise
method.description: Removes the noise generator called [param name].

method.name: remove_rng
method.description: Removes the random stream called [param name]. A later [method get_rng] with this name creates a new stream that starts from the beginning.

method.name: set_seed_from_text
method.description: Sets [member global_seed] to [method text_to_seed] of [param text] and returns it. For example, [code]"Daily-2026-11-23"[/code] gives every player the same daily challenge.

method.name: set_state
method.description: Restores a state from [method get_state]: sets [member global_seed], reseeds all streams and noise generators, then restores the state of every stream in [param state]. Streams that do not exist yet are created. Emits [signal seed_changed].

method.name: text_to_seed
method.description: Returns the seed for [param text] without setting it. The value is the same on every platform and in every engine version.

members.member: The seed all streams and noise generators derive from. Setting it reseeds every stream and noise generator, so they start from the beginning, and emits [signal seed_changed]. It starts at [code]0[/code]; call [method randomize_seed] for a random run.
If [code]true[/code], the global random functions ([method @GlobalScope.randi], [method @GlobalScope.randf] and others) are seeded with [member global_seed] whenever it changes.

signal.name: seed_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [member global_seed] is set, also by [method set_seed_from_text], [method randomize_seed] and [method set_state]. Always emitted on the main thread.
